items.title: Apollo Is Focused on Investment Grade, De Giorgi Says
items.summary: Diego De Giorgi, partner and head of EMEA at Apollo Global Management, says the firm is focused on the global industrial renaissance and is particularly focused on investment-grade and the short end of curve. Speaking to Anna Edwards at Bloomberg's Global Credit Forum in London, he also says he expects a higher rate environment in 2027 alongside what he describes as the largest capex cycle in history.

items.title: Apollo Global Management (APO) Sees AI Needing $8 Trillion Of Capital
items.summary: Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) CEO Marc Rowan warned that the AI buildout could require about US$8 trillion of capital. Rowan argued that this AI funding need may push more borrowing into private credit and away from traditional U.S. bond markets. He flagged that financing large scale AI infrastructure could influence borrowing costs and funding access for companies outside the tech sector. items.title: SpaceX “Off Balance Sheet” Debt for AI Chips Hits the Market This Week. Here’s Where Things Get Interesting
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSome of a $40 billion debt package to buy Nvidia chips for SpaceX could go on sale as soon as this week, Bloomberg reported. The debt sits in a separate vehicle off SpaceX’s balance sheet, and critics like Ed Zitron want that kind of deal regulated away.
